title: Sun Mergers & Acquisitions Adopts Navatar Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) CRM for Cloud Computing and Navatar Deal Connect (Deal Sourcing for Private Equity Funds)
主要内容: Sun Mergers & Acquisitions has adopted Navatar's M&A Cloud and Navatar Deal Connect to manage their M&A business and build worldwide connections. Navatar's M&A CRM enables boutique M&A firms, investment bankers, and business brokers to discover potential clients, find the right buyers, and manage the entire due diligence process without spending on software, hardware, or professional services. The solution allows them to operate from anywhere using laptops or mobile devices. Navatar M&A CRM is fully integrated with Navatar Deal Connect, a free global online marketplace for middle market transactions. Sun Mergers & Acquisitions has adopted Navatar Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) CRM for cloud computing and deal sourcing. The platform enables better qualified target companies based on buyer's search criteria and tracks all buyer transaction history. Navatar's M&A runs entirely in Salesforce.com's cloud and is available for a low monthly fee. The platform is used by global firms such as PNC, Jefferies & Co and Evercore Partners.
